pay_detail: Wages start at $15.50 an hour, about 20 hours a week (2026).
duration: 8 or 9 weeks in summer (the pages differ). 2026: June 15 to Aug 14.
name: Wanda Fullmore Youth Internship Program
org: Common Wealth Development with the City of Madison
what_you_do: A summer internship with mandatory training and weekly professional development. The library page says it is organized by Common Wealth Development for Madison youth to get involved with local government.
who_can_apply: Students who are at least 14 years old when they apply. They must live in the City of Madison limits or attend a Madison Metropolitan School.
deadline_text: Common Wealth Development says applications open in mid January and close at the end of March. In 2026 they closed March 20, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: In 2026 the steps were a youth application, a parent or guardian application and an interview. Questions: youth@cwd.org or (608) 256-3527.
notes: The library page says 8 weeks and Common Wealth Development says 9, so confirm. Interns get a Chromebook, a bus pass and elective school credit. The pay rate and steps come from a January 2026 City of Madison post, so confirm them for 2027.
